facts.text: Glassvale Academy is a hidden magical school tucked inside a mountain valley behind a shimmering waterfall curtain called The Mistgate.

Students enter Glassvale Academy at age eleven, learn basics of all three disciplines in Common Term, and then specialize in one of three Paths: Path of Makers (engineering and science), Path of Nature (weather, animals, plants, teamwork), or Path of Pure Magic (powerful, mysterious, hard-to-control raw magic).
Each Path has a forbidden dark section: Cold-Iron (Makers) and The Blight (Nature) are milder and easier to contain, while Shadow Magic (Pure Magic) is far deeper, spookier, and more dangerous.
Headmistress Monica leads all of Glassvale Academy, mentors Clara, and insists on buying the second most expensive version of everything because she thinks only show-offs buy the first.

The three Path Leader Teachers are Jorge (Path of Makers), Marissa (Path of Nature), and Peter (Path of Pure Magic). Clara does not start out close to Jorge or Marissa; she builds strong trust with them during Book 1.

The World-Glass is an ancient three-chambered hourglass (golden clockwork dust, living emerald seeds, liquid starlight) split long ago into five hidden pieces: Crown Seal, Maker Chamber, Nature Chamber, Starlight Chamber, and Silver Frame.

SECRET (DO NOT DISCLOSE BEFORE BOOK 5): Peter is secretly a member of The Hollow Circle, the evil association hunting the five pieces of the World-Glass. His small antique brass sand-timer acts as a quiet seeker dial, though to everyone at Glassvale he looks completely warm, fit, noble, and trustworthy.

Clara's core best friends at Glassvale Academy are Maya (Path of Nature, sporty with a turquoise Glow-Frog named Pebble) and Sam (Path of Pure Magic, quirky ginger-haired friend with crooked glasses). Makers students such as Ben and Nora appear only as secondary classmates alongside Jorge.

Visual appearances locked by author-approved concept sheets: Clara (11, straight light-brown hair with bangs, silver-star clip, slate-blue cloak), Maya (11, sporty Black girl, bouncy curls, mustard bandana, olive utility vest, muddy boots, turquoise Glow-Frog Pebble), Sam (11, curly ginger hair, crooked round glasses, burgundy sweater under open navy waistcoat), Monica (adult, silver-streaked hair in bun, thin silver glasses on chain, teal-and-silver robes), Jorge (witty inventor, tousled dark hair, goggles, leather tool vest), Marissa (Asian, leaf-woven dark braid, emerald cloak, moss-feathered Bramble-Owl Pip), Peter (tall, fit, athletic Black man, deep-plum and gold robes, small antique brass sand-timer), Victor (12, neat blond hair, crisp navy-and-silver jacket, leather gloves).

The Crown Seal is the first piece of the World-Glass, hidden beneath Glassvale's central Bell-Tower behind three Path locks and defended by the three academy bells (Brass, Leaf, Star) ringing together.
